# The paths each instrument watches: the one list per instrument workflow, read by the workflow's
# first step after its checkout (.github/scripts/watch.mjs) and by the workflow policy test
# (.github/scripts/policy.test.mjs). The workflows themselves carry no `paths:` filter, since a
# workflow that a filter skips never reports, and so cannot be a required check of `main`
# (docs/design-review.md, guard-per-problem).
#
# Each section is `[<file in .github/workflows>]`, then one glob a line, as GitHub's `paths:`
# filters read them: `**` crosses directories, `*` does not. `merge_group: skip` marks a heavy
# instrument that ran on the pull request's head and does not run again in the merge queue.
#
# A list names everything its jobs build or read: Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, rust-toolchain.toml and
# every crate the job builds (the policy test computes them from the manifests), its own workflow,
# and the corpora it reads. A change to this file or to watch.mjs runs every instrument.

[mutants.yml]
merge_group: skip
compiler/**
# A workspace member: the baseline runs its tests, though .cargo/mutants.toml mutates none of it.
spikes/tier1-latency/**
Cargo.toml
Cargo.lock
rust-toolchain.toml
.cargo/mutants.toml
.config/nextest.toml
.github/workflows/mutants.yml

[generated.yml]
compiler/**
conformance/**
